whenToUse: A row of cards or testimonials that would not fit; a fading hero slider; a gallery with thumbnails.
A swipeable KPI strip on phones.
avoidWhen: Content users must see — carousels hide everything except the first slide.
A full photo grid — use Gallery grid or Gallery section.
a11y: Follows the WAI-ARIA carousel pattern; autoplay pauses on hover, focus and reduced motion, and has a pause button.
